title: Italian Aubergine Quesadilla
description: A unique Italian twist on traditional quesadillas, featuring aubergine as the main ingredient. Serve as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Slice the aubergine into thin strips and sauté until tender.
Place a quesadilla in the pan and sprinkle with the cheese and kebab seasoning.
Top with the cooked aubergine and fold the quesadilla in half.
Cook until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
